$description: The site's two shadow recipes. Both are two-layer: a tight contact shadow plus a wide soft one, and both go deeper on dark, where the surface alone gives less separation. `panel` lifts the mega-menu panel; `popup` is the same recipe scaled down for the place-map popup — it was written by reading the panel's numbers, which is why they now share a source. Read by tailwind.config.js, which emits --box-shadow-*; main-nav.css and place-map.css reference those. The -dark variants are separate tokens rather than a themes block because tailwind emits one flat :root, and the blocks pick the right one under [data-theme='dark']. NOT yet emitted to Penpot: its plugin API rejects every documented shape for a shadow token value (see the LOG entry for 2026-08-22), so the import shape is unverified and emitting it blindly would risk the theme sets on the next import.
